mods.name: Advanced Admin UI
mods.description: A comprehensive client-side admin tool suite for Holdfast: Nations at War. Features include Cavalry Visualization, Rambo Indicator, AFK Indicator, Minimap, and Admin UI.
mods.author: Xarkanoth
mods.changelog: See GitHub releases for full changelog.

mods.name: Custom Splash Screen
mods.description: Replace the Holdfast splash screen with custom videos! Select from pre-defined splash videos or use your own custom video file. Press F8 in-game to configure.
mods.author: Xarkanoth
mods.changelog: v1.0.0 - Initial release with settings UI and video selection.

mods.name: Custom Crosshairs
mods.description: Replace weapon crosshairs with custom images! Configure via the launcher settings.
mods.author: Xarkanoth
mods.changelog: v1.0.6 - Custom crosshair replacement with settings UI.

mods.name: Map Capture
mods.description: Exports Holdfast terrain, scene meshes, materials, textures, vegetation, lighting, spawn sections, and an overhead color map. Pick official maps from the main menu, or run a local rotation.
mods.author: Xarkanoth
mods.requirements: Requires LauncherCoreMod. Harvest tool for local map rotations.
mods.changelog: v1.2.8 - Photographs the terrain at 4096 and the sky as a panorama. Keeps tree trunks that sit outside LOD groups. Reads Better Lit tints and dumps TVE grass settings to materials.json. Water alpha, height 512, bigger mesh and grass caps. v1.2.7 keeps every texture.
